useCases.title: Auditd Rule Violation Detection
useCases.value: Auditd violations provide forensic evidence of security incidents and unauthorized system access.

useCases.title: Password Policy Violation Detection
useCases.value: Password policy violations indicate accounts with weak credentials vulnerable to compromise.

useCases.title: Audit Policy Changes
useCases.value: Attackers modify audit policies to disable logging and hide their activities. Any unauthorized audit policy change must be investigated immediately.

useCases.title: Process Creation with Command Line Auditing
useCases.value: Full command-line visibility on process creation is the foundation of threat detection. Reveals encoded PowerShell, LOLBin abuse, and suspicious child processes.

useCases.title: IAM Policy Changes
useCases.value: IAM policy changes affect who can do what across the entire AWS account. Unauthorized policy attachments can grant admin access.

useCases.title: Database User and Privilege Change Audit
useCases.value: New users, role grants, or privilege changes can indicate compromise or policy violation. Auditing supports compliance (SOX, PCI) and security investigations.

useCases.title: Database Audit Log Tampering Detection
useCases.value: Detects unexpected audit trail disable, audit file deletion, or Unified Audit policy changes that may indicate cover-up activity.

useCases.title: Brute-Force Login Detection
useCases.value: Brute-force attacks are a primary credential compromise vector. Early detection prevents account takeover.

useCases.title: Privileged Group Membership Changes
useCases.value: Adding accounts to Domain Admins or Enterprise Admins (EventCode 4728/4732/4756) in minutes limits blast radius from stolen Tier-0 credentials. Immediate detection supports audit evidence for privile…

useCases.title: MFA Challenge Failure Rate
useCases.value: High MFA failure rates indicate user friction, potential phishing, or MFA fatigue attacks. Monitoring supports both security and user experience.

useCases.title: Privileged Session Audit
useCases.value: Complete audit trail of privileged sessions is required for compliance (SOX, PCI, HIPAA) and security investigation.

useCases.title: Okta User Lifecycle Events (Provisioning / Deprovisioning)
useCases.value: Orphaned accounts, failed deprovisions, and unexpected creates drive audit findings and residual access after employee exit.

useCases.title: Secret Exposure Detection
useCases.value: Secrets committed to source control are immediately compromised. Detection within minutes enables rapid rotation before exploitation.

useCases.title: User Search Activity Audit (_audit)
useCases.value: Auditing who ran which searches supports insider-threat investigations and segregation of duties.

useCases.title: Configuration File Change Tracking (_audit)
useCases.value: Unauthorized `.conf` edits change data access and ingestion behavior; rapid detection limits blast radius.

useCases.title: Knowledge Object Modification Audit (_audit)
useCases.value: Dashboard and alert tampering can hide attacks or exfiltration; object-level audit supports SOC and GRC.

useCases.title: Role and Capability Change Detection (_audit)
useCases.value: Privilege escalation via new roles/capabilities must be detected in minutes, not days.
